thread:
noah: Confidential ask. I have social anxiety and in-person calibration panels and live verbal feedback are really triggering. Can I request written-only feedback for my mid-cycle and be excused from being on interview panels for the next 6 weeks? Im worried about how this shows up in the review process and recruiter schedules.
emma (People Ops): Thanks for telling us, @noah. We can absolutely support alternative feedback formats and temporary interview exemptions. Two quick items: 1) Please submit the "Communication & Participation Accommodation" form so we can document this confidentially; 2) well coordinate with your manager and Recruiting to reassign interview slots. This will be kept private (HR + manager).
ravi (Manager): Noah, Im fully supportive. Written feedback is fine for the mid-cycle; I can provide structured notes and short written summaries after 1:1s. For interviews, Ill swap you out of panels and ask Recruiting to route your slots elsewhere for 6 weeks. Want me to draft a private manager note for the review packet?
noah: Thanks, Ravi. Yes please add a short private note that clarifies the accommodation dates but not medical details. Also prefer asynchronous interview options (take-home tasks or recorded panels) if recruiting needs my input later.
emma (People Ops): Noted. We can request async contributions (reviewing written take-homes) instead of live interviews. We will log the accommodation: written-only feedback (mid-cycle) + interview-panel exemption + option for async interview work. If you need more time, we can extend.
hr_bot: Action required: submit form https://redwood.internal/forms/comm-participation-accom. Creating private case notifies People Ops and manager only.
ravi (Manager): Ill update the calibration preparer with a private note: "Noah: written feedback only, accommodation period 6 weeks." This gives reviewers context without details. Recruiting: @ana, can you confirm interview swaps?
noah: I DMd the list of my upcoming panel dates to Recruiting. Appreciate the quick help and confidentiality. One last ask: will this affect eligibility for promotion this cycle?
emma (People Ops): Short answer: no. Alternative feedback or temporary panel exemptions are not negative signals. We will not surface medical or disability details to the performance committee. We can add a private annotation indicating an accommodation was in place during dates X3Y so reviewers know context.
noah: Perfect. Thank you both  I feel much better having this documented privately.
emma (People Ops): Action logged: accommodation-created for noah (type: comm-participation, start: 2300001111, planned-end: 2300256311). Notifications to People Ops and manager only. Follow-up: well do a 2-week check-in.
ravi (Manager): Ill handle the interview swaps and prepare the written feedback notes per the usual template. Ping me if anything else comes up. :thumbsup:
noah: Closing the loop. Will reach out if I need an extension.
